fields.summary_ko.0: Palantir (PLTR) stock declined 1.65% following Q3 earnings, with U.S. commercial segment total contract value (TCV) growth of 11% YoY raising concerns about slowdown compared to Q2's 153% growth.
fields.summary_ko.1: Revenue nearly doubled YoY and exceeded $2 billion for the first time, though shorter contract duration is cited as a key factor.
